reason: A web UI enhancement that adds an interactive animated whale pet with cursor tracking, dragging, keyboard activation, and visual effects.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加一只可游动、拖拽、点击互动并跟随鼠标视线的动画鲸鱼桌宠。
summaries.en: Adds an animated whale companion to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that swims, follows the cursor, and supports dragging and click or keyboard interactions.

capabilities: Adds a persistent animated whale companion to the web UI
Tracks the mouse cursor for eye animation
Supports drag, click, and keyboard activation interactions
Displays visual and text-like bubble effects within the UI
